dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low-contrast, blurry pale edges visible along the boundaries of the folded lower wing feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, elliptical high-contrast white patch visible on the lateral-posterior region of the head.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent transverse black and white banding on the tail feathers; red soft-tissue/cere visible at the anterior-most point of the head.
